first: pytest + Ruff; notebooks for exploration, scripts for pipelines
concepts: Testing, types, linting, debugging, reproducibility

first: NumPy + pandas; DuckDB for SQL over files
concepts: Shapes, vectorization, types, missing values, joins, columnar storage

first: SQLite first, PostgreSQL for services
concepts: SQL, schema, transactions, indexes, migrations

first: scikit-learn, one boosting library when justified
concepts: Splits, baselines, preprocessing, objectives, tuning

first: PyTorch deeply; others for the selected team/role
concepts: Autograd, tensor programs, training loops, compilation

first: Transformers + Datasets
concepts: Model cards, dataset licenses, tokenization, device mapping

first: PEFT/TRL only when adapting a model
concepts: SFT, LoRA, quantization, preference objectives, memory

first: One modality stack for a real task
concepts: Image transforms, spectrograms, encoders, diffusion, modality metrics

first: One simple environment and one implementation
concepts: MDP, rewards, value/policy, exploration, reproducibility

first: One provider SDK, then optional gateway
concepts: Network failures, schemas, model capabilities, accounting

first: One embedding model and a measured reranker
concepts: Representation, normalization, asymmetric retrieval, multilingual performance

first: Exact small baseline, then FAISS/ANN as needed
concepts: kNN versus ANN, HNSW/IVF/PQ, recall-memory-latency trade-offs

first: pgvector OR Qdrant; compare one alternative
concepts: Persistence, filters, updates/deletes, replicas, tenant boundaries

first: BM25 baseline + optional RRF
concepts: Token statistics, rank fusion, filters, reranking

first: Choose one parser based on corpus; evaluate extraction
concepts: OCR/layout, tables, metadata, source offsets, freshness

first: Plain Python baseline, then one framework
concepts: Ingestion/index/query boundaries, component replacement, observable pipelines

first: Plain loop → LangGraph in depth
concepts: State, tools, budgets, checkpoints, replay, review

first: Awareness; verify current migration/support docs before selecting
concepts: Contracts, orchestration, interoperability; team-specific adoption

first: Pydantic/schema validation first; DSPy after a scored task exists
concepts: Typed outputs, optimization objectives, validation and repair

first: HTTP/tool contracts, then MCP
concepts: Client/server boundaries, transports, auth, capabilities, versioning

first: Small gold dataset + deterministic scoring; add one tool
concepts: Task metrics, held-out data, judge bias, regression and contamination

first: One tracing tool with safe data handling

first: Small local model, then vLLM for GPU service if needed
concepts: Quantization, batching, KV cache, TTFT, throughput, memory

first: FastAPI + Gradio first; React when custom UX warrants it
concepts: Contracts, validation, streaming, loading/errors, usability

first: MLflow and versioned datasets; feature store only if needed
concepts: Lineage, artifacts, registries, train/serve skew

first: One orchestrator for a real scheduled workload
concepts: DAGs, retries, idempotency, backfills, data contracts

first: Docker + CI + one deployment target
concepts: Images, secrets, rollout, rollback, autoscaling, SLOs

first: Service metrics + simple data checks
concepts: Data quality, drift, label delay, alerting and incidents

first: PyTorch profiling, then DDP; kernels for systems specialty
concepts: Memory hierarchy, collectives, parallelism, bottleneck analysis

first: Threat model, application permissions and deterministic validation first
concepts: Untrusted data, least privilege, sandbox limits, adversarial eval

first: Provisional Expo/React Native route, see app specification
concepts: Offline data, notifications, permission UX, progress and scheduling
